newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian lead, tin prices fall, other metals steady.
newsitem.headline: Indian lead, tin prices fall, other metals steady.

text.p: Lead and tin prices nosedived on the metal market on Friday, dealer said.

Lead prices fell by 75 rupees to 4,850 rupees per quintal on unloading by the stockist following reports of weak trend in the world market. "Fear of Hindustan Zinc slashing lead prices for next month also hurt the sentiment," they said.
Tin fell by 200 rupees to 35,400 rupees per quintal on increased arrivals of the imported metal.
Copper was steady at 11,600 rupees per quintal. So was nickel at 37,200 rupees and aluminium at 7,200 rupees per quintal. Zinc was quiet at 6,225 rupees per quintal.
